Kimberly / Ben — I reviewed the MAP draft. A couple of suggestions to tighten risk:

- Canary cohort: limit to auth and balance-check flows only (no settlement/clearing) for first 48 hours. That minimizes stateful KV divergence.
- Monitoring: add a dedicated latency SLO dashboard (token pctiles) + prompt-set regression checks.
- Fallback: auto-roll back to hosted fallback model variant if error rate > 3% for 10 minutes.

I'll mark these as redlines in the XLSX. Also propose adding a dry-run window (1 day) before canary to warm caches and run replayed traffic.
